report.explanation: The recommended strategy is to expedite shipping for ORD-1002, which is the only affected order. evidence.description: Alpha Components supplies SKU-SENSOR; scheduled replenishment 40 units on 2026-10-27. Injected delay 5 calendar days moves arrival to 2026-11-01.
10 on-hand units as of 2026-10-25; allocate by promised date, then order ID. Full-order completion is required; warehouse-to-customer transit is zero days.
ORD-1001: 10 units due 2026-10-26; stock allocation 10, shortfall 0; complete 2026-10-25; 0 days late × GBP 50.00/order/day = GBP 0.00. Penalty applies to the whole order, not each unit.
ORD-1002: 20 units due 2026-10-27; stock allocation 0, shortfall 20; complete 2026-11-01; 5 days late × GBP 100.00/order/day = GBP 500.00. Penalty applies to the whole order, not each unit.

Expedite: 5 days saved, 40 units, GBP 100.00 + 3.00/unit. Alternative: 2 days, 20 units, GBP 100.00 + 8.00/unit. Costs are incremental fees plus residual penalties; common base procurement, taxes, weekends, cancellation, split-delivery benefits, and transit are excluded. Unused regular/alternative units have no modeled charge. Recovery fees are hypothetical.
